item.title: NASCAR Driver Wrecks Car in the Infield Grass Following Congratulating Teammate on First Win
item.description: Sam Mayer junked his No. 41 after entering the grass too fast after tapping his teammate Sheldon Creed following his first O’Reilly Series win.

item.title: Tyler Reddick Wrangles Damaged Race Car to Second Straight NASCAR Cup Series Win to Open the Season
item.description: Tyler Reddick becomes just the sixth driver in NASCAR history to win the first two races of the season, as 23XI Racing tops the NASCAR standings through the first two races.

item.title: Tested: 2026 Jeep Cherokee Limited Brings Back the Famous Name
item.description: The Cherokee is reborn as a hybrid-only take on the mid-size crossover, combining impressive economy with more off-road ability than rivals.

item.title: Lamborghini Bins Lanzador EV As Auto Industry Pulls Back on Electric Cars
item.description: CEO Stephan Winkelmann sees PHEVs as the path forward amid a shifting global response to pure electric machinery.

item.title: Yuki Tsunoda’s Red Bull RB7 F1 Car Catches Fire While Doing Donuts in San Francisco
item.description: The Red Bull reserve driver was behind the wheel of Sebastian Vettel's championship-winning RB7 when it all went wrong.

item.title: Mercedes-Benz Reportedly Planning Hybrid 'Little g' G-Wagen Alongside EV
item.description: The diminutive sibling of the G-Class was initially announced as an electric-only product.

item.title: Tested: 2026 Mazda CX-5 Remains an Excellent Choice
item.description: The overlap with the slightly fancier CX-50 means Mazda probably doesn't need to make the CX-5 still, but we're glad it does.

item.title: Many NYC Gas Stations Selling Regular Gas as Premium, Report Suggests
item.description: 96 percent of gas stations inspected in NYC between 2023 and 2025 failed tests by city inspectors, with the wrong octane numbers being the leading problem by far.

item.title: The Polestar 6 Has Reportedly Been Delayed to 2029, May Not Happen at All
item.description: Initially due on the streets this year, Polestar's glamorous convertible is now penciled in for the end of the decade.

item.title: Why Aston Martin’s $63 Million F1 Naming Deal Is a Win for Both Sides
item.description: The naming rights deal isn’t as strange as it sounds at first blush.
